pages.text: The survivors kept a ledger of what was taken and by whom. It is the spine of this almanac, and of the $(l:patchouli:tech/how_blueprints_work)Blueprint ladder$().$(br2)$(bold)Brass$() went with the dead. $(bold)Gunpowder$() with the creepers. The $(bold)drill$() that made soldiers of farmers went with the skeletons.

$(bold)Trains$() rusted in a chamber under the hills, guarded by an iron thing that will not leave. $(bold)Ships$() sank off the stony shores where the nagas nest. The $(bold)trading ledgers$() went to the illager fort.$(br2)$(bold)Diesel$() burns in a savanna shrine. The $(bold)diving gear$() lies in the ocean monuments. The $(bold)hearth$() froze with the frostmaw; the $(bold)cannons$() went to the frosted prison. The reactor's $(bold)precision parts$() glow in the Nether.

And something was taken to the End that no one has named. The ledger's last line is blank.$(br2)$(italic)Every entry in this list is a boss in the $()$(l:patchouli:bosses/where_they_are)Bestiary$()$(italic).$()
